rules.interaction: Notice-only rule; does not restrict causes for eviction.

rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental agreements, including a single unit

rules.title: Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance
rules.requirement: Cambridge landlords must give tenants a rights and resources guide at the start of a tenancy and when legal steps to end it are taken. It does not stop a landlord from starting an eviction otherwise allowed by law.
rules.key_value: guide at lease start and with notice to quit; fine $300 per day
rules.quoted_span: This Ordinance does not prevent a landlord from initiating an eviction action if otherwise allowed by law.
